title: stuff is getting detected as stealers

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue reports that temporary error and session JSON files were quarantined by antivirus software as malware (Generic.PyStealer). Antivirus detections on local JSON session files are usually false positives triggered by content or code snippets saved in chat history, but the report lacks the specific prompt or conversation content necessary to reproduce or investigate the issue.
triage_metadata.comment: Hi! Thanks for commenting on this issue, we need more information to triage the bug. Antivirus detections on local session files are typically false positives caused by text or code snippets saved during a session. Could you please provide the prompt or conversation content active prior to the quarantine, along with the name of the antivirus software flagging these files?
